fact: Portarias 50/2024 and 51/2024 of 27 December 2024 declared the phased entry into service of the SIJ and its criminal procedure subsystem SIPP, from 1 January 2025 in the Praia and São Vicente courts.
title: Portaria Conjunta nº 50/2024 e Portaria nº 51/2024
publisher: Ministério da Justiça e Ministério da Administração Interna, Boletim Oficial
